current_legal_basis: The held U.S. Code (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted from 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-14 are not reflected in the held edition) prints the full text of Executive Order 10854, as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 11382, as a note under 49 U.S.C. 40120 with no ending statement. The authority the order cites, section 1110 of the Federal Aviation Act of 1958 (49 App. U.S.C. 1510), is restated in the held text of 49 U.S.C. 40120(b), under which the President may extend the application of that part outside the United States when an international arrangement gives the United States Government authority and the President decides the extension is in the national interest. The held eCFR text of 14 CFR parts 71 and 73 (GovInfo title 14, amended through 2026-11-09) cites E.O. 10854, 24 FR 9565, in each part's authority line, and the FAA's final rule at 89 FR 14379 (Feb. 27, 2024) states that the Administrator consulted the Secretaries of State and Defense in accordance with Executive Order 10854. The bounded searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog found no revocation or ending of the order; the Federal Register disposition notes list only the amendment by EO 11382 and a cross-reference to EO 11326.
reason: The single command of EO 10854 was operative on 2026-10-14 as amended. EO 11326 section 7 removed the Ryukyu Islands from the order's applicability on signing, and EO 11382 section 6(a) replaced the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Agency with the Secretary of Transportation; neither ends the order, and the order's text has no term or condition. The current Code note prints the order as amended and 49 U.S.C. 40120(b) preserves the presidential authority on which it rests.
inventory_reason: The dossier scope covers characters 0-1278, which are the tail of the preceding order on the same page. The operative text of EO 10854 runs from 'By virtue of the authority vested in me' through the end of its proviso ('national defense.'); the heading before it and the signature block after it are not operative text.
